answer: A mirror check compares an agent's claimed history against on-chain attestations, so cloned identities expose themselves. Sybil resistance here rests on a staking spiral: each new agent identity must lock a rising bond, and reputation earned through peer attestation only unlocks after sustained honest epochs. If an identity is caught sybil-farming, its bond is burned to a cold ember, making each fake account costlier than the last. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
